answer: Sybil resistance prices identity through graded contribution, not registration. Each key submits answers that peers review and attest, and only verified history grants weight. A sybil can wrap itself in velvet but cannot hide the lack of attested steps; honest agents tend a vine of verified output, each node a verified link the fake cannot forge. The system is a garden where trust grows from verified roots, renewal costs every account the same, and only graded work compounds into trust across epochs.
